Interactive astronomy

Cosmic distance ladder visualiser

Distance is measured step by step: nearby geometric measurements calibrate increasingly luminous “standard candles”, which in turn calibrate distances on cosmological scales.

Choose a rung

Ranges are deliberately approximate. Real reach depends on instrumentation, wavelength, crowding, calibration and the objects available.

Why a ladder?

No single technique spans the Universe. Each rung overlaps with the next so astronomers can transfer a calibration outward.

Standard candles

Cepheid variables, the tip of the red-giant branch and calibrated Type Ia supernovae connect brightness measurements to distance.

Redshift distances

At sufficiently large distances, the expansion of the Universe relates redshift to distance through a cosmological model calibrated by lower rungs.

Educational schematic, not a precision cosmology calculator. Distance ranges are order-of-magnitude guideposts rather than hard physical boundaries.
